replies.author: SnowSX3
replies.body:
Staff can't be on 24/7 which is why sometime you need to take evidence of these things and send them into us.
(either via email or through an online report)

Yes, the job of a Moderator is to monitor the server but the community needs to help us too. "The staff need to do a better job" isn't a good suggestion because we can only do so much.
With these situations, did you use /report?

And if no staff were present did you take evidence somthat you could give it to us at a later time?

If you didn't then I suggest you start doing that.

With chat related situations, screenshots will suffice, however, if it's non-chat related, video evidence is required.

Thanks for showing interest in improving the server!
